title: Git Foundations
description: Version control with Git: where a change lives (working copy, staging area, commits), branches, undoing mistakes, setting work aside, working with a remote, resolving merge conflicts, merge versus rebase, and pull-request review including checking AI-made changes.
sourceCoverageNotes: Source slice: F2 rows 0-4 (all five Git rows) and F3 rows 0-3. Each source row maps to one page here, except F3 row 2, which this module shares with ai-foundations.
F3 row 3 'Git and shell review' is the final page here, kind review: it revisits concepts already taught and adds no new syllabus.
F3 row 4 'Tooling module check' is not duplicated here; ai-foundations owns its formative page and the course owns its assessment blueprint.

F3 row 2 'Pull requests, review comments and checking AI-made changes before merging' is shared: pull-requests-and-review teaches PR mechanics and review comments and links to ai-foundations/checking-ai-changes for substantive AI-change checking.
